about: A fresh setup with no voice service: the bot reply's Message actions menu, opened from its more button.

script.text: The Q3 summary is ready: 14 clients, 312 hours, £48,200 billed.

type.name: Message Pepper
type.text: Total the Q3 hours by client

steps.eval: const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-mid]')].filter((row) => row.textContent.includes('Q3 summary is ready')); const more = rows.at(-1).querySelector('button[aria-haspopup=menu]'); more.click();
